- Option B — EU-friendly: Tue/Thu afternoon CET (15:00–17:00 CET)
- Option C — APAC-friendly: Wed/Thu evening JST (20:00–22:00 JST)

I've attached a draft POC agenda and network/topology stub for the load run. If you can share preferred time windows and any required participants (SRE/networking/security), I'll coordinate invites.
